summary.intent: Plan and then execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage), a backend crypto/security coverage phase for CipherBox, using the GSD plan-phase and execute-phase workflows with --chain for auto-advance.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans across 2 waves, verified with 0 blockers), all artifacts committed, and Wave 1 Plan 58-01 was spawned as a subagent executor. The transcript ends mid-execution of 58-01.

repo: Phase 58 structure: 4 plans in 2 waves — Wave 1: 58-01 (CBOR cid/sequence binding + Rust resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint) and 58-02 (D-09 embedded-sequence gate in upsertFolderIpns); Wave 2: 58-03 (web/sdk-core resolve dedup) and 58-04 (cross-language verify vectors).
Rust dependency constraint: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core, so cross-language test vectors must live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/.
Plan 58-02 is not fully autonomous — it pauses for a human checkpoint at the D-10 full-SDK-E2E gate and requires the local stack (docker compose + API on 3000, redis on 6380).
Local stack was confirmed running during planning: redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo all up.

RESEARCH.md open questions headings must carry a (RESOLVED) marker after planning or the plan checker emits a warning — all three questions in 58-RESEARCH.md were substantively answered in-plan but the marker was missing.
GSD VALIDATION.md frontmatter is required when Nyquist is enabled; body scaffold is owned by execute/validate tooling, not the planner.
AUTO_CHAIN=true causes plan-phase to automatically invoke execute-phase on successful plan verification.
ASVS L1 security gate is active for this phase — each PLAN.md must include a threat_model block; high-severity threats are blockers.

code.finding: 9 unverified FUSE resolve sites need routing through the new resolve_ipns_verified wrapper (8 unverified + 1 folder-key descent hard-fail site).
Cross-language Rust verify vectors (7 cases) must live here, not in crates/crypto/tests/, due to the crypto crate's dev-dependency constraint.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch was chosen over parallel-worktree execution for this security-critical phase to avoid cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees — a deliberate correctness-over-speed tradeoff.
The GSD commit helper can report commit_failed as a false negative; always verify with git log rather than retrying the commit.
The plan checker's cosmetic warning (RESOLVED marker missing from RESEARCH.md) can be fixed with a direct file edit rather than triggering a full planner revision cycle.
Pattern mapper runs as a distinct subagent before the planner when no PATTERNS.md exists; it produced a 14-file classification for this phase.
In --chain / AUTO_CHAIN mode, the orchestrator auto-advances from plan-phase to execute-phase without a user confirmation step.

friction: commit_failed false-negative from the GSD commit helper on the VALIDATION.md commit (known issue; required a git log verification step).
RESEARCH.md open questions section was missing the (RESOLVED) marker, causing a plan checker warning and requiring a post-verification file edit.
open_items: Plan 58-01 executor was still running (subagent) when the transcript ended — outcome unknown.
Plan 58-02 requires human approval at the D-10 full-SDK-E2E checkpoint before it can complete.
Wave 2 plans (58-03 resolve dedup, 58-04 cross-language vectors) have not yet been executed.
Pre-existing Cargo.lock modification was present on the branch but left untouched — not part of Phase 58 scope.
